data_card.measured: Upstream water levels in a laboratory channel with and without a bridge, at four flows; afflux is the difference at the same flow (W5-105 TR2J Table 4.1).
data_card.method: Laboratory flume measurements reported in the Environment Agency benchmark; the instrument uncertainty is not reported.
data_card.uncertainty: Values are published to 0.5 mm; instrument uncertainty is not reported.
known_issues: Reuse terms of the 2004 report not yet confirmed.
data_card.exercises: The head loss through a bridge opening: contraction, piers and expansion, against a paired no-bridge run.
data_card.cannot_tell: With only four values, a bridge loss coefficient can be tuned to match; the test is only meaningful when the bridge is modelled from its geometry with the engine's documented method (a T0 or T1 configuration).

validation_design.holdout_policy: No calibration: the bridge is represented from its geometry with the engine's own method; a loss coefficient fitted to the measured afflux is not accepted.

title: EA W5-105 Test J: measured bridge afflux
description: Upstream water-level rise caused by a bridge, measured in the laboratory at four flows (W5-105 Test J, TR2J Table 4.1): the depth with the bridge minus the depth without it, at the same flow.

citations.title: Benchmarking of hydraulic river modelling software packages (Test J: bridge afflux)
citations.report_number: Environment Agency R&D Technical Report W5-105/TR2

provenance.adaptation_notes: Draft. HydroCouple transcribed the four measured afflux values (HydroCouple OpenSWMM benchmarks corpus, corpus/uk-ea-river/uk-river-j (commit 3f490b5); values rounded to 0.5 mm; source rights not independently verified). They are not copied here until the report's reuse terms are confirmed. A model must represent the bridge itself; an arbitrary loss coefficient fitted to the afflux is not a valid run.

pending.reason: Channel and bridge geometry and the four flows from W5-105/TR2 Test J.
pending.obtain_from: Environment Agency W5-105/TR2; HydroCouple OpenSWMM benchmarks corpus, corpus/uk-ea-river/uk-river-j (commit 3f490b5)

uncertainty.notes: Rounding of the published values (0.5 mm); instrument uncertainty is not reported in the source.

criteria.rationale: Afflux (bridge minus no-bridge upstream level at the same flow) within 1 cm at each of the four flows. Provisional, written before any run.
